title: STUN: improve heuristic to detect TURN ChannelData
description:
Commit 873d5980cd1 improved STUN heuristic to match TURN ChannelData messages.
It was based on the assumption that, looking at the "stun.type.method" field,
it should be trivial to determine if the current packet carries a TURN message
or not.

However, at least one STUN/TURN implementation (Facetime) uses
unknown/custom TURN methods to set up a Channel Data. Fortunately, standard
TURN attributes are still used in the replies.

Improve such heuristic taking into account specific TURN attributes, too.
The list attributes have been taken from RFC5766.

You can reproduce the issue with the attached pcap
[stun_channel_facetime.pcapng](/uploads/94e1f369aa91d623a33ce94d15466950/stun_channel_facetime.pcapng)
where packets 7-20 are not properly detected as "ChannelData TURN message" without this patch.
